privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.dataLead: We only keep what is needed to run the family app and billing:
privacy.dataPinHash: a hash of the admin PIN (not the PIN itself);
privacy.dataStripe: Stripe identifiers (customer, subscription, checkout) for payment.
privacy.purposeBody: This data is used to run the family app and to handle billing (trial and subscription). We do not sell your data.
privacy.processorsBody: We use Google Firebase (hosting, authentication, database, cloud functions) and Stripe (payments). They process data on behalf of the controller identified above.
privacy.cookiesBody: We do not set analytics cookies. There is no Firebase Analytics / gtag in this app.
privacy.deletionHtml: You can request deletion of your account and data via . We will handle that request as soon as possible.
privacy.lawBody: Belgian law applies. The controller is established in Belgium.
terms.title: Terms of use
terms.productBody: Kids Reward System is a Belgian dad’s product: a family app for tasks, rewards and screen time.
terms.priceBody: After a 30-day trial, the subscription auto-renews at €2.50 per month or €25 per year unless you cancel. Founder or promo codes can make it free forever.
terms.cancelBody: You can cancel via the Stripe customer portal (in the app, under Subscription).
terms.withdrawBody: EU consumers have 14 days to withdraw. Using the app during the trial may affect that right (performance of the service during the withdrawal period).
legal.paidNote: For questions before or during the trial: kidsrewardsystem@proton.me. The full legal name and geographic address are displayed in the app after the first paid invoice (not during the 30-day trial, and not if a promo makes the subscription free).
